Name: Jarmuth in Issachar
Description: A Levitical city in Issachar named in Joshua 21, which the parallel list in 1 Chronicles 6 gives as Ramoth — a northern Jarmuth, distinct from the Canaanite royal city of the same name in the Shephelah.
BiblicalSignificance: As a city given to the Levites, this Jarmuth served the Gershonites in Issachar; its double name (Jarmuth/Ramoth) explains why it must not be merged with Judah's Jarmuth.
